code:
import pandas_market_calendars as mcal

nyse = mcal.get_calendar("NYSE")
schedule = nyse.schedule(
    start_date="2023-01-01", end_date="2023-12-31"
)
trading_days = schedule.index

missing = trading_days.difference(prices.index)
caption: Compare against the actual exchange calendar before calling something a gap.

code:
roll_med = returns.rolling(21, center=True).median()
abs_dev = (returns - roll_med).abs()
mad = abs_dev.rolling(21, center=True).median()

robust_z = 0.6745 * (returns - roll_med) / mad
flagged = robust_z.abs() > 8
caption: Median/MAD catches implausible prints without flagging real fat-tail moves.
